runtime.listLimit: admin SEO meta list clamps request limit by maxListRows
runtime.requestLimit: admin SEO meta save/delete reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.previewUi: ability page can preview effective SEO meta by content id or slug through seo.meta
runtime.previewResultUi: ability page renders content/category SEO preview as effective meta and template-variable tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.variableValuePreview: seo.meta includes templateVariables so ability page preview can show actual token values
runtime.categoryVariablePreview: ability page can preview category SEO meta and category template variable values by category id or slug
runtime.templateWarningPreview: ability page preview reports unresolved {token} placeholders in effective content/category SEO output
runtime.accessIntegration: seo.meta hides restricted content metadata through content.access when that pack is enabled
runtime.statusValidation: SEO meta save normalizes status to enabled/disabled values before writing
